explanation.headline: Ceftazidime is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; one labeler is marked To Be Discontinued

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows ceftazidime is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The list does include an entry for Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, with status To Be Discontinued posted on 2025-11-14.
No public FDA signal at our plants has been recorded for ceftazidime.
Current inventory across three sites ranges from 12.0 to 30.7 days on hand for the 2 g presentation and 15.8 to 26.3 days for the 1 g presentation.
The rule‑based best option is to buy from Sagent Pharmaceuticals, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Sagent's label does not name a plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
